assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All spatial metrics are computed from provisional_rough interim geometry, not an official redline. Confidence is low and the values are interim design-model outputs.
assumptions.impact: site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio and every derived value must be recomputed when the official boundary and official key-area polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: The interim polygon labelled as the Dazhongsi cluster has its centroid near Beijing North Station, inconsistent with the name (upstream Issue #1029, ~2.26 km).
assumptions.impact: The southern area is referred to only as the South Gateway; its structure, area, and derived metrics must be recomputed once the location is clarified.

assumptions.statement: simulation.json records a fixed-seed offline synthetic rehearsal. No online model call, no physical robot, and no personal data are involved.
assumptions.impact: Readings prove recomputability under a frozen task manifest. They are not field measurements and are not a commitment about real-world performance or approval to operate.

assumptions.statement: The graded scenario admission mechanism, the blame-free failure reporting rule, and the fallback service floor have no existing statutory basis.
assumptions.impact: All three are conceptual policy suggestions requiring separate institutional authorisation; they are not presented as decided arrangements.

assumptions.statement: The taskbook review dimension names 北纬社区 (Beiwei Community) as a regional coordination partner, but neither the repository nor the public brief provides any definition material (function, location, scale). This proposal does not infer any of these and proposes only mechanism-level coordination (shared ledger standard, reciprocal scenario rehearsal, cross-checked resident-jury records).
assumptions.impact: The Beiwei Community row of the regional coordination table stays mechanism-only until the organizer supplies definition material; the other coordination rows and all spatial layers are unaffected.
